Container.Name: SearXNG
Container.Overview: SearXNG self-hosted metasearch engine. Used as a local, private web-search backend for the Home Assistant Assist voice pipeline (Ollama tool-calling), so the local LLM can answer general/current-events questions without any cloud search API. JSON API is enabled (search.formats includes json in settings.yml) for the HA web_search script to consume.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the SearXNG web/JSON API

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent settings.yml (JSON API enabled here for HA)

Config.Name: SEARXNG_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Base URL SearXNG reports to itself

Config.Name: Cache Path
Config.Description: SearXNG runtime cache (was an anonymous docker volume before this template)
